name: studiomeyer
description: StudioMeyer MCP Suite for Claude Code. Hosted SaaS plugins: Memory (56 tools, knowledge graph), CRM (37 tools, contacts + pipeline), GEO (30 tools, AI visibility across 8 LLMs), Crew (13 expert personas). Plus the Academy MCP (open source, 19 tools, lessons + recipes + tutor). All five include Claude Code v2.1.118 mcp_tool hook recipes for fully agentic workflows. Magic Link authentication. EU Frankfurt hosting. Memory and CRM have a free tier plus Pro EUR 9 and Team EUR 19 per month; GEO, Crew and Academy are free.

plugins.name: studiomeyer-memory
plugins.description: Hosted AI memory with 56 tools. Knowledge Graph, semantic search, contradiction detection, multi-agent namespaces, import from ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Copilot/Perplexity. Magic Link auth. Free tier (200 calls/day), Pro EUR 9/mo, Team EUR 19/mo. Includes 4 mcp_tool hook recipes (Stop, PreCompact, UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStop) for fully agentic memory.

plugins.name: studiomeyer-crm
plugins.description: Headless CRM as MCP server. 37 tools for contacts, companies, deals, pipeline, leads, follow-ups, notes, health scores, Stripe sync. Zero-Knowledge credential storage. Free (50 companies), Pro EUR 9/mo, Team EUR 19/mo. Includes 2 mcp_tool hook recipes (UserPromptSubmit auto-lookup, PostToolUse email-draft logger).

plugins.name: studiomeyer-geo
plugins.description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). 30 tools to measure and improve AI visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, Meta AI, Copilot. Discovery stack audits, JSON-LD validation, schema generator, async job/poll checks. Free tier (most tools without API keys). Includes 1 mcp_tool hook recipe (Stop with if-filter on *.md/*.mdx auto-audits visibility after content edits).

plugins.name: studiomeyer-crew
plugins.description: 13 expert agent personas: 8 standard roles (CEO, CFO, CMO, CTO, PM, Analyst, Creative Director, Support Lead) plus 5 specialists (Data Scientist, DevRel, Legal Advisor, Sales Engineer, UX Researcher), plus 3 multi-persona workflows. Zero extra API cost, runs inside your Claude subscription. Free, no paid tier. Includes 1 mcp_tool hook recipe (Stop auto-feedback) plus an optional bash SessionStart hook for cwd-aware persona-suggestion.

plugins.name: studiomeyer-academy
plugins.description: Memory-First AI Operator School. 19 tools: lessons, quiz, recipes, knowledge graph, certificates, AI tutor. Open Source MCP server (npm: mcp-academy, MIT). Free, with no paid tier and no account needed: all 6 levels, the full lesson tree and 58 published recipes. Includes 2 mcp_tool hook recipes (SessionStart auto-stats + PostToolUse quiz cascade).
